mapper.select: SELECT store_category_code as categoryCode, store_category_name as categoryName FROM store_category

SELECT s.store_code, s.store_name, s.store_category_code, s.description, s.thumbnail_url, MAX(CASE WHEN sl.user_code = #{userCode} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liked, l.address, i.image_code, l.latitude, l.longitude FROM store s LEFT JOIN store_like sl ON s.store_code = sl.store_code LEFT JOIN location l ON s.location_code = l.location_code LEFT JOIN image i ON i.reference_type = 'STORE' AND s.store_code::text = i.reference_code WHERE s.store_status = 'APPROVE' GROUP BY s.store_code, l.address, i.image_code, l.latitude, l.longitude, l.area_code

SELECT s.store_code, s.store_name, s.store_category_code, s.description, s.thumbnail_url, MAX(CASE WHEN sl.user_code = #{userCode} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liked, l.address, i.image_code, l.latitude, l.longitude FROM store s LEFT JOIN store_like sl ON s.store_code = sl.store_code INNER JOIN location l ON s.location_code = l.location_code LEFT JOIN image i ON i.reference_type = 'STORE' AND s.store_code::text = i.reference_code WHERE s.store_status = 'APPROVE' AND l.latitude IS NOT NULL AND l.longitude IS NOT NULL AND ( 6371 * acos( LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0, cos(radians(#{latitude})) * cos(radians(l.latitude)) * cos(radians(l.longitude) - radians(#{longitude})) + sin(radians(#{latitude})) * sin(radians(l.latitude)) )) ) ) <= #{radiusKm} GROUP BY s.store_code, l.address, i.image_code, l.latitude, l.longitude, l.area_code ORDER BY 6371 * acos( LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0, cos(radians(#{latitude})) * cos(radians(l.latitude)) * cos(radians(l.longitude) - radians(#{longitude})) + sin(radians(#{latitude})) * sin(radians(l.latitude)) )) ) ASC
SELECT path FROM image WHERE image_code = #{imageCode}

SELECT s.store_code, s.created_at, s.store_name, s.store_status, a.area_name FROM store s LEFT JOIN location l ON s.location_code = l.location_code LEFT JOIN area a ON l.area_code = a.area_code WHERE s.store_status = #{storeStatus} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT #{criteria.limit} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store ( store_name, store_status, store_phone, store_link, store_business_hours, location_code, store_category_code, store_food_type, detail_address, description, store_breaktime_hours, thumbnail_url, user_code ) VALUES ( #{storeCreateDTO.storeName}, #{storeCreateDTO.storeStatus}, #{storeCreateDTO.storePhone}, #{storeCreateDTO.storeLink}, #{storeCreateDTO.storeBusinessHours}, #{locationCode}, #{storeCreateDTO.storeCategoryCode}, #{storeCreateDTO.storeFoodType}, #{storeCreateDTO.detailAddress}, #{storeCreateDTO.description}, #{storeCreateDTO.storeBreaktimeHours}, #{storeCreateDTO.thumbnailUrl}, #{storeCreateDTO.userCode}::uuid )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store WHERE user_code = #{userCode}::uuid

SELECT s.store_code, s.created_at, s.store_name, s.store_status, a.area_name FROM store s LEFT JOIN location l ON s.location_code = l.location_code LEFT JOIN area a ON l.area_code = a.area_code WHERE s.user_code = #{userCode}::uuid ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT #{criteria.limit} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}

SELECT s.store_code, s.store_name, s.store_category_code, c.store_category_name, s.store_status, s.store_phone, s.store_link, s.store_business_hours, CONCAT_WS(' ', l.address, s.detail_address) AS address, s.detail_address, s.description, s.store_breaktime_hours, s.thumbnail_url, ( SELECT COUNT(like_code) FROM store_like sl WHERE sl.store_code = #{storeCode} ) AS like_count, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM store_like sl WHERE sl.store_code = #{storeCode} AND sl.user_code = #{userCode} ) AS liked, l.latitude, l.longitude, i.image_code, i.path FROM store s LEFT JOIN store_like sl ON s.store_code = sl.store_code LEFT JOIN location l ON s.location_code = l.location_code LEFT JOIN store_category c ON s.store_category_code = c.store_category_code LEFT JOIN image i ON s.store_code::text = i.reference_code AND i.reference_type = 'STORE' WHERE s.store_code = #{storeCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE store SET store_name = #{updateDTO.storeName}, store_status = #{updateDTO.storeStatus}, store_phone = #{updateDTO.storePhone}, store_link = #{updateDTO.storeLink}, store_business_hours = #{updateDTO.storeBusinessHours}, location_code = #{locationCode}, store_category_code = #{updateDTO.storeCategoryCode}, store_food_type = #{updateDTO.storeFoodType}, detail_address = #{updateDTO.detailAddress}, description = #{updateDTO.description}, store_breaktime_hours = #{updateDTO.storeBreaktimeHours}, thumbnail_url = #{updateDTO.thumbnailUrl}, user_code = #{updateDTO.userCode}::uuid
mapper.select: SELECT user_code FROM store WHERE store_code = #{storeCode}
